content.label: let vs const vs var
content.value: Use const by default, let when reassignment is needed, avoid var. var is function-scoped and hoisted in ways that create bugs.

content.label: == vs ===
content.value: Prefer ===. == performs coercion, which is useful only when you deliberately want null == undefined.

content.label: truthy/falsy
content.value: Falsy values: false, 0, -0, 0n, '', null, undefined, NaN. Everything else is truthy, including [] and {}.

content.label: optional chaining
content.value: user?.profile?.name safely stops at null/undefined. Combine with ?? for defaults.

content.label: nullish coalescing
content.value: value ?? fallback only falls back on null or undefined. It preserves 0, false, and empty string.

content.label: Closure
content.value: A function keeps access to variables from the scope where it was created. Used for callbacks, factories, memoization, and encapsulation.

content.label: Arrow functions
content.value: Lexical this, no own arguments, not constructible. Great for callbacks; avoid for prototype methods needing dynamic this.

content.label: Hoisting
content.value: Function declarations are usable before declaration. let/const are hoisted but inaccessible before initialization.

content.label: this
content.value: Depends on call site for regular functions. Use bind/call/apply or arrow functions when callback context matters.

content.label: Promise
content.value: Represents a future success or failure. Chain with then/catch or consume with async/await.

content.label: await
content.value: Pauses the async function, not the thread. Rejections become thrown errors inside the async function.

content.label: Promise.all
content.value: Run independent tasks concurrently; rejects fast on first rejection.

content.label: Promise.allSettled
content.value: Use when every result matters, even failures.

content.label: Microtasks
content.value: Promise callbacks run before timers after the current call stack completes.

content.label: querySelector
content.value: CSS selector based DOM lookup. Cache stable nodes instead of repeatedly querying inside hot paths.

content.label: event delegation
content.value: Attach one listener to a parent and inspect event.target. Useful for dynamic lists.

content.label: fetch
content.value: Rejects on network failure, not on HTTP 400/500. Check response.ok before parsing.

content.label: localStorage
content.value: Synchronous key-value storage. Good for small preferences, not large or sensitive data.

content.label: ES modules
content.value: Static import/export enables tree-shaking and clear dependencies. Dynamic import supports code splitting.

content.label: Testing
content.value: Unit test pure logic, integration test async/API boundaries, e2e test critical user flows.

content.label: XSS defense
content.value: Treat user input as untrusted. Prefer textContent/framework escaping over innerHTML.

content.label: Performance
content.value: Ship less JavaScript, split non-critical code, avoid long tasks, clean up listeners and timers.

content.label: Node errors
content.value: Use async/await with try/catch at boundaries. Never ignore rejected promises.
